snippet.title: How Much More Will You Test Me Lord | Elara Faith
snippet.description:
How Much More Will You Test Me, Lord is an emotional Christian worship song for anyone walking through pain, unanswered prayers, fear, loneliness, and difficult seasons. A heartfelt cry to God when your faith feels weak, yet you’re still holding on.

If you’re going through a battle today, may this song remind you that you are not alone. Keep praying. Keep believing. God is near, even in the silence.

#ChristianWorship #WorshipSong #Prayer #God #Faith

Lyrics
[Verse 1]
I’ve been walking through these shadows
With a heart too tired to pray
Every night I bring my questions
But the answers fade away
I have smiled when I was breaking
I have said that I’m okay
But You know the tears I’m hiding
You know every word I cannot say

[Pre-Chorus]
I have carried this for so long
I don’t know how much is left
So I’m falling at Your feet now
With this weakness in my chest

[Chorus]
How much more will You test me, Lord?
How much more can my heart endure?
How many tears will I have to cry
Before I see the morning light?
I’ve held on when I wanted to let go
I’ve kept believing when I couldn’t know
If You are here, then hear my cry
How much more, Lord?
How much more tonight?

[Verse 2]
There are battles no one sees here
There are wounds I never show
There are prayers I’ve prayed in silence
Only You and I would know
I have watched my dreams grow distant
I have lost what I held dear
And sometimes faith feels like a whisper
When the pain is all I hear

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t need another answer
I just need to know You’re near
If You won’t remove this mountain
Give me strength to face it here

[Chorus]
How much more will You test me, Lord?
How much more can my heart endure?
How many tears will I have to cry
Before I see the morning light?
I’ve held on when I wanted to let go
I’ve kept believing when I couldn’t know
If You are here, then hear my cry
How much more, Lord?
How much more tonight?

[Verse 3]
When the doors keep closing slowly
And the road won’t show the way
When the people I depended on
Are no longer there to stay
When the fear becomes a prison
And tomorrow feels too far
I will bring You every burden
Every broken, wounded part

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t understand Your silence
I don’t understand this pain
But somewhere underneath the sorrow
I still whisper out Your name

[Chorus]
How much more will You test me, Lord?
How much more can my heart endure?
How many tears will I have to cry
Before I see the morning light?
I’ve held on when I wanted to let go
I’ve kept believing when I couldn’t know
If You are here, then hear my cry
How much more, Lord?
How much more tonight?

[Bridge – Emotional Climax]
If this is where my faith is tested
Then hold me while I’m weak
When I cannot see tomorrow
Be the strength I need

I’m still here, Lord
Though I’m hurting
I’m still calling out Your name

[Final Chorus – Powerful & Emotional]
How much more will You test me, Lord?
I don’t know how much more I can take
But I’m still holding on to You
Even when my heart begins to break

How much more, Lord?
How much more?
Through this darkness, stay with me
Until I see the morning light

I may not understand Your silence
I may not understand this pain
But even through my darkest night
I’ll still whisper out Your name
